Application Data.NAME: Gems & Timepieces, Inc.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Diamond Way, Suite 100, Los Angeles, CA 90015-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gems & Timepieces, Inc. is a premier jewelry and watch retailer specializing in high-quality gemstones, luxury watches, and custom-designed jewelry pieces. Our operations include sourcing unique, ethically mined diamonds and other precious stones, offering expert jewelry repair and appraisal services, and providing personalized customer consultations to help clients find or create the perfect piece for any occasion. We cater to a diverse clientele, from first-time buyers to seasoned collectors, and focus on delivering exceptional customer service and a memorable shopping experience in a secure and welcoming environment.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft occurred at our store, resulting in the loss of several high-value watches totaling $2,500. The incident was reported to the police and is currently under investigation. The status of the claim with GemShield Insurance Company is pending.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security surveillance system and on-site security personnel for enhanced protection.
